about: Job titles with the role, level, ladder and entry mark each must get in the tech role set (role null: none of its seven roles). Labelled on 2026-11-05 by two model readers that read only a written spec (data/experiments/scratch/tech-role-set/spec.md, summarised in PLAN.md, 'A third role set') and never the rules: 480 titles drawn by plain keyword (420) and at random (60), seed 11, from a census of the 1,098 Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards in the registry ('drawn': keyword, random), 236 written to probe the borders with the product and MBA sets, hardware, banks and the ladders ('written'), and 32 entry and internship titles ('written-entry'). On 2026-11-06, 90 bare titles ('Senior Engineer', 'Designer, Toys') from postings the refresh kept, spread over employer industries ('bare-border', with the employer's industry), labelled by one reader from the same spec after the fresh sample showed them; the employer's industry decides them (pipeline/roles_tech.py, BARE). Rows with sure=false are reported, not counted. Checked by evals/run_pipeline.py --roles tech. When a check fails, fix the rule; change a label only with the reason in its note.
